Parent & Child Discovery Workshops Four Parent & Child workshops are coming to Chorlton this November and December. Perfect for parents and children to discover the club together before the children start attending on their own. 📅 Dates: 21 & 28 November • 5 & 12 December 🕙 Time: 10:00–11:00 💛 Price: £9 per session (child + parent) ☕ Includes: Drinks & biscuits Each workshop has a different theme — perfect for trying out the club before January. Places are limited — join the waiting list: leclubfrancofun@outlook.com Le Club Francofun is a fun, activity-based French club for children aged 3 to 12 years old , in Chorlton. A simple playful approach designed for both beginners and bilingual children. What we do? 🎨 In this French club, children experience French differently — through stories, games, crafts, songs, sensory activities and gentle immersion. Joyful, natural, pressure‑free… simply the pleasure of language.
